title: Core: Library item CRUD operations
description: Unit tests for adding, removing, and updating library items (Symbol, BitmapItem, SoundItem) on a FlashDocument. Look for addLibraryItem / removeLibraryItem / updateLibraryItem in packages/core/src/engine/. If not implemented, add them to packages/core/src/engine/library.ts and export from index.ts. Tests in packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/library-crud.test.ts.
